families.rationale: Minimum ordinary two-byte target, two finite samples, with unequal displacements.
Long dense local word; each key remains far below the per-key decay threshold.
Long local sparse alignment, interior nils and a missing trailing tap; same ordered samples as a short control.
Spelling can differ while normalized byte lengths match; taps refer to intended keys.
One source Character expands to two keyed bytes and duplicates its tap.
Expansion and spelling correction coexist at equal normalized lengths.
Extra nonfinite taps beyond the text must not contribute or reject.
Punctuation-position nonfinite taps are ignored; compare identical text with nil punctuation tap.
Contributing NaN rejects after a settled independent seed.
Contributing negative and positive infinity are rejected in separate calls without teaching.
A one-byte alignment mismatch rejects finite taps after a settled seed.
Omitted taps and explicit all-nil taps both reject; these are two checks within one family.
Zero-byte and one-byte targets reject even with otherwise finite taps.
Learning-off rejects valid aligned input without changing settled local or persisted authority.
Nil URL construction, accepted learns, rejected learn and explicit save occur in an empty isolated cwd; all directory entries are compared.
Short persistent sparse learn with absent trailing taps must match the same ordered short local samples through save/reopen.
Exactly forty finite dense letter samples persist and reopen.
A long target with forty actual samples must persist; the short control preserves their order and one-call grouping.
A target far longer than forty with only one finite contributing sample persists; a two-byte short control has the identical one-sample call.
Forty-one actual samples reject with invalid status and preserve a settled seed and every authority-family entry.
Long sparse oversize is still forty-one actual samples, preserving the seeded authority exactly.
Twenty-one source taps become forty actual letter samples; sample cap uses expansion multiplicity.
Twenty-one original taps become forty-two actual samples and must reject without disturbing the seed.
Twelve independent four-sample calls accumulate forty-eight samples; the cap is per call and grouping is identical in the local control.
